source_publisher: Tomislav Duricic (Graz University of Technology / Know-Center GmbH)
approved_components: TechManualQA_700.jsonl: 700 question-answer pairs with document/page references and quality scores
human_annotation/: inter-annotator audit spreadsheets (general and procedural tasks, annotators A and B)
excluded_components: Source technical manual PDFs are not included in the archive and must be obtained separately from the original manufacturers
required_raw_sources: 20 technical manual PDFs listed at https://github.com/tduricic/techmanualqa (Covered Manuals section)
reason: TechManualQA-700 is a well-documented, CC-BY-4.0-licensed retrieval QA benchmark for technical manuals. It provides exact doc_id/page_number mappings for 600 answerable questions, 100 unanswerable questions, automated RAGAS scores, LLM-judge scores, and a human audit subset (~262 questions) with κ=0.82. Major limitations are the absence of the raw source PDFs in the archive and the lack of a predefined train/dev/test split, which limit immediate end-to-end retrieval evaluation. Evaluation score 71/100 maps to APPROVE_EVAL_CANDIDATE; capped at technically_verified_candidate pending domain review.
